name: kesav
description: Browse, read and edit your whole repo in a pane beside Claude Code's transcript: file tree with git and Claude-edit markers, fuzzy find, highlighted view, markdown, diffs, and an in-pane editor

autoOpen.title: Open on start
autoOpen.description: Dock the repo pane at session start when the terminal is wide enough

follow.title: Follow Claude's edits
follow.description: Show each file Claude edits in the pane as it happens

width.title: Pane width
width.description: Share of the terminal the docked pane asks for, in percent (20-70; at least 44 columns, and Claude keeps 70). Dragging the divider wins
